items.title: 52220_Woody Herman oral history interview
items.q: Now, he left you and then went back to work and study with Lennie Leonard Tristano.

ctx.x: Now, he left you and then went back to work and study with Lennie Leonard Tristano.
Yeah, that's right. And he's still playing. He's still around New York. And I run into him once in awhile. As a matter of fact, we had him at the 40th anniversary.
